Muse Institute of Aesthetic Medicine · Crows Nest

Skin, treated with a plan — not a guess.

A non-surgical cosmetic clinic led by a medical director, built around proven laser and light devices and a consultation first. No treatment prices are published here: your plan, and its fee, are discussed at consultation.

Price range: $$$ · Consultation-led · Crows Nest, on Sydney’s lower north shore

The device room, in plain language

Eight named platforms, one purpose: treat the concern properly, with the right tool, rather than forcing every face through the same treatment.

Also offered: skin tightening and lifting, collagen stimulation, hyperhidrosis treatment, anti-wrinkle injections, chemical peels and the Glass Facial.

Doctor-led, by design

Medical Director Dr Stephen Lowe

Muse is a non-surgical cosmetic clinic led by Medical Director Dr Stephen Lowe (MED0001207553). That matters when a treatment is medical: assessment comes first, the device is matched to the diagnosis, and the plan is explained before anything is booked in.

Rejuran skin booster: 30–45 minute sessions, typically 3–4 sessions spaced 2–4 weeks apart. Your exact course is confirmed at consultation.

Book a consultation

Start from the concern

Tell us what bothers you. The consultation decides which device — if any — is right for it.

Pigmentation & sun damage

Uneven tone and sun-related change, assessed under clinical light before a device is chosen.

Redness & vessels

Visible redness and vessels, matched to a light-based platform rather than a one-size treatment.

Texture & pores

Rough texture and enlarged-looking pores, with resurfacing considered only where suitable.

Fine lines

Early lines and skin quality, planned alongside tightening and collagen-stimulating options.

Acne scarring

Scarring assessed by type and depth, because different scars respond to different approaches.

Not sure yet?

That is what the consultation is for. Bring your questions; leave with a written-style plan, not pressure.

Questions, answered straight

Why are no treatment prices published?

Muse is consultation-led. Fees depend on the device, the area and the number of sessions your plan needs, so they are discussed at consultation rather than listed as a single figure.

Do I need a consultation before treatment?

Yes. Assessment comes first so the right device is chosen for your concern, and unsuitable treatments are ruled out early.

Where is the clinic?

114 Alexander Street, Crows Nest NSW 2065, on Sydney’s lower north shore. Hours: Mon, Tue, Wed & Fri 09:30–18:00; Thu 09:30–20:00; Sat 10:00–16:00; Sun Closed.

What does the $$$ tag mean?

It is a general price-range indicator only. It is not a quote for any treatment.
